entities.summary: Kendrick John Ray is an American professional basketball player for Mykonos of the Greek Basketball League. He played college basketball for Quinnipiac University and Kennesaw State University before playing professionally in the Czech Republic, Israel, France, Turkey and Greece. Standing at 6 ft 2 in (1.88 m), Ray plays at the shooting guard and point guard positions.
